name: modal
title: Modal
description: HBD modal: a centred overlay dialog HAND-PORTED from hbd-modal.js (no Radix) so the .is-open / .is-closing transitionend close lifecycle is preserved 1:1 — close() applies .is-closing, keeps it until the dialog's opacity transitionend, THEN releases scroll-lock + restores focus + fires onClose. Portals a backdrop / container / dialog tree into document.body with EVERY legacy .hbd-modal* BEM class re-applied (role=dialog/alertdialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby). Reproduces focus-trap across Light DOM + open shadow roots, body-scroll-lock (shared counter), return-focus, an always-available Escape exit (even with noClose, SC 2.1.2), backdrop / container click-to-dismiss (noBackdropClose opt-out), host-level [data-modal-close] delegation, stacked z via --hbd-z-modal/--hbd-z-overlay, and an alertdialog sub-type that focuses its first (cancel) footer button on open. Sizes sm/md(default)/lg/full map --hbd-modal-width-*. Controlled-first overlay: open + onOpenChange + defaultOpen, plus onOpen/onClose bridging the WC's hbd:open/hbd:close. Compound Modal + Modal.Footer (slot=footer) / Modal.Close ([data-modal-close]). Pairs with the de-shadowed modal.css.
